22884-the-dragon-painter.title: The Dragon Painter
22884-the-dragon-painter.creator: MARY McNEIL FENOLLOSA
22884-the-dragon-painter.description: A book by MARY McNEIL FENOLLOSA. cow it; snow falls upon its temple roofs, swings in wet, dazzling masses from the bamboo plumes, or balances in white strata along green-black pine branches. The summer sun scorches the face of Yeddo, and summer rain comes down in wide bands of light.

64690-the-dead-star-rover.title: The Dead Star Rover
64690-the-dead-star-rover.creator: Unknown
64690-the-dead-star-rover.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Midway in the thought it did happen, and with almost catastrophic suddenness. The black silhouette of a flying thing materialized out of the sun's glare, diving straight at him. It flattened out and was gone overhead, while the roar of its passing echoed behind it.

arxiv-1409-4163.title: The Derivative Degree Sequences of Finite Simple Connected Graphs are Parking Functions
arxiv-1409-4163.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by . Parking functions are well researched and interesting results are found in the listed references and more. Some introductory results stemming from application to degree sequences of simple connected graphs are provided in this paper.

arxiv-1804-02139.title: Lightweight Mobile Ad-hoc Network Routing Protocols for Smartphones
arxiv-1804-02139.creator: Md Shahzamal
arxiv-1804-02139.description: Abstract Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) is one of the promising wireless networking approaches where a group of wireless devices can establish communication among themselves without any infrastructure. MANET has successfully been implemented in the emergency communication, battlefield and Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) etc. Recently, MANET has also been studied to establish village level off-the-grid telephony system using mobile phones (smartphones).

arxiv-1903-00254.title: The unirational components of the strata of genus 11 11 curves with several pencils of degree 6 6 in ℳ 11 \mathcal{M}_{11}
arxiv-1903-00254.creator: Hanieh Keneshlou, Frank-Olaf Schreyer
arxiv-1903-00254.description: Abstract We show that the strata ℳ 11 , 6 ​ ( k ) ⊂ ℳ 11 \mathcal{M}_{11,6}(k)\subset\mathcal{M}_{11} of 6 − 6- gonal curves of genus 11 11 , equipped with k k mutually independent and type I pencils of degree six, have a unirational irreducible component for 5 ≤ k ≤ 9 5\leq k\leq 9 .

arxiv-2008-10582.title: A Unified Framework for Light Spanners
arxiv-2008-10582.creator: Hung Le, Shay Solomon
arxiv-2008-10582.description: Abstract Seminal works on light spanners over the years provide spanners with optimal lightness in various graph classes, 1 1 1 The lightness is a normalized notion of weight: a graph’s lightness is the ratio of its weight to the MST weight.

arxiv-2109-11677.title: Security Review of Ethereum Beacon Clients
arxiv-2109-11677.creator: JP Aumasson – Taurus, Switzerland –
arxiv-2109-11677.description: Abstract The beacon chain is the backbone of the Ethereum’s evolution towards a proof-of-stake-based scalable network. Beacon clients are the applications implementing the services required to operate the beacon chain, namely validators, beacon nodes, and slashers. Security defects in beacon clients could lead to loss of funds, consensus rules violation, network congestion, and other inconveniences.

arxiv-2202-00446.title: Multi-Order Networks for Action Unit Detection
arxiv-2202-00446.creator: Gauthier Tallec, Arnaud Dapogny, Kévin Bailly
arxiv-2202-00446.description: Abstract Action Units (AU) are muscular activations used to describe facial expressions. Therefore accurate AU recognition unlocks unbiaised face representation which can improve face-based affective computing applications. From a learning standpoint AU detection is a multi-task problem with strong inter-task dependencies.

arxiv-2202-11004.title: A novel active veto prototype detector with an inner target for improved rare event searches Journal: arxiv.org
arxiv-2202-11004.creator: M. Chaudhuri, A. Jastram, G. Agnolet, S. Banik, H. Chen, V. Iyer, V. K. S. Kashyap, A. Kubik, M. Lee, R. Mahapatra, S. Maludze, N. Mirabolfathi, N. Mishra, B. Mohanty, H. Neog, M. Platt
arxiv-2202-11004.description: Abstract We report the fabrication and performance of an annular, cryogenic, phonon-mediated veto detector that can host an inner target detector, allowing substantial reduction in radiogenic backgrounds for rare event search experiments. A germanium veto detector of mass ∼ \sim 500 g with an outer diameter of 76 mm and an inner diameter of 28 mm was produced.

arxiv-2210-16615.title: Progress on levitating a sphere in cryogenic fluids
arxiv-2210-16615.creator: M. Arrayás, F. Bettsworth, R. P. Haley, R. Schanen, J. L. Trueba, C. Uriarte, V. V. Zavjalov, D. E. Zmeev
arxiv-2210-16615.description: Abstract We present the working prototype of a levitation system designed for investigation of flows in cryogenic helium fluids. The current device allows the levitation of a superconducting sphere and has several provisions made for allowing precise control over its motion.

arxiv-2303-15787.title: A groupoid approach to the Wodzicki residue
arxiv-2303-15787.creator: Nathan Couchet, Robert Yuncken
arxiv-2303-15787.description: Abstract Originally, the noncommutative residue was studied in the 80’s by Wodzicki in his thesis [ 33 ] and Guillemin [ 18 ] . In this article we give a definition of the Wodzicki residue, using the langage of r r -fibered distributions from [ 24 ] , [ 30 ] , in the context of filtered manifolds.

arxiv-2305-17949.title: A Learning-based Nonlinear Model Predictive Controller for a Real Go-Kart based on Black-box Dynamics Modeling through Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2305-17949.creator: Enrico Picotti, Enrico Mion, Alberto Dalla Libera, Josip Pavlovic, Andrea Censi, Emilio Frazzoli, Alessandro Beghi, Mattia Bruschetta
arxiv-2305-17949.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Enrico Picotti, Enrico Mion, Alberto Dalla Libera, Josip Pavlovic, Andrea Censi, Emilio Frazzoli, Alessandro Beghi, Mattia Bruschetta. Lately, Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) has been successfully applied to (semi-) autonomous driving problems and has proven to be a very promising technique. However, accurate control models for real vehicles could require costly and time-demanding specific measurements.

arxiv-2306-03819.title: LEACE: Perfect linear concept erasure in closed form
arxiv-2306-03819.creator: Nora Belrose, David Schneider-Joseph, Shauli Ravfogel, Ryan Cotterell, Edward Raff, Stella Biderman
arxiv-2306-03819.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nora Belrose, David Schneider-Joseph, Shauli Ravfogel, Ryan Cotterell, Edward Raff, Stella Biderman. Concept erasure aims to remove specified features from an embedding. It can improve fairness (e.g. preventing a classifier from using gender or race) and interpretability (e.g. removing a concept to observe changes in model behavior). We introduce LEAst-squares Concept Erasure (LEACE), a closed-form method which provably prevents all linear classifiers from detecting a concept while changing the embedding as little as possible, as measured by a broad class of norms.

arxiv-2408-06242.title: Enhanced stability and chaotic condensates in multi-species non-reciprocal mixtures
arxiv-2408-06242.creator: Laya Parkavousi, Navdeep Rana, Ramin Golestanian, Suropriya Saha
arxiv-2408-06242.description: Abstract Random non-reciprocal interactions between a large number of conserved densities are shown to enhance the stability of the system towards pattern formation. The enhanced stability is an exact result when the number of species approaches infinity and is confirmed numerically by simulations of the multi-species non-reciprocal Cahn-Hilliard model.

arxiv-2409-08960.title: Improving governance outcomes through AI documentation: Bridging theory and practice DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26 – May 1, 2025, 2025; Yokohama, Japan ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2409-08960.creator: Amy A. Winecoff, Miranda Bogen
arxiv-2409-08960.description: Abstract . Documentation plays a crucial role in both external accountability and internal governance of AI systems. Although there are many proposals for documenting AI data, models, systems, and methods, the ways these practices enhance governance as well as the challenges practitioners and organizations face with documentation remain underexplored.

arxiv-2409-13872.title: Don’t Call Us, We’ll Call You Journal: PACMPL Volume: 1 X 1 5 CCS: Software and its engineering Semantics
arxiv-2409-13872.creator: Jan Liam Verter, Tomas Petricek
arxiv-2409-13872.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jan Liam Verter, Tomas Petricek. There are two kinds of systems that programming language researchers use for their work. Semantics engineering tools let them interactively explore their definitions, while proof assistants can be used to check the proofs of their properties. The disconnect between the two kinds of systems leads to errors in accepted publications and also limits the modes of interaction available when writing proofs.

arxiv-2410-21273.title: On Inductive Biases That Enable Generalization of Diffusion Transformers
arxiv-2410-21273.creator: Jie An, De Wang, Pengsheng Guo, Jiebo Luo, Alexander Schwing
arxiv-2410-21273.description: Abstract Recent work studying the generalization of diffusion models with UNet-based denoisers reveals inductive biases that can be expressed via geometry-adaptive harmonic bases. However, in practice, more recent denoising networks are often based on transformers, e . g ., the diffusion transformer (DiT).

arxiv-2505-22994.title: Walking the Weight Manifold: a Topological Approach to Conditioning Inspired by Neuromodulation
arxiv-2505-22994.creator: Ari S. Benjamin, Kyle Daruwalla, Christian Pehle, Anthony Zador
arxiv-2505-22994.description: Abstract One frequently wishes to learn a range of similar tasks as efficiently as possible, re-using knowledge across tasks. In artificial neural networks, this is typically accomplished by conditioning a network upon task context by injecting context as input. Brains have a different strategy: the parameters themselves are modulated as a function of various neuromodulators such as serotonin.

cia-0000136963.title: Cable Request That Publicize Strength of Anti Communist Sentiment Within Guate
cia-0000136963.creator: Central Intelligence Agency
cia-0000136963.source: Internet Archive — CIA Reading Room mirror
cia-0000136963.description: Declassified CIA document 0000136963, dated 1 May 1954. Subject: CABLE REQUEST THAT PUBLICIZE STRENGTH OF ANTI COMMUNIST SENTIMENT WITHIN GUATE.

pmc-10654197.title: Disparities in Obstetric, Neonatal, and Birth Outcomes Among Syrian Women Refugees and Jordanian Women
pmc-10654197.creator: Tariq N. Al-Shatanawi, Yousef Khader, Nadin Abdel Razeq, Ahmed M. Khader, Mahmoud Alfaqih, Osama Alkouri, Mohammad Alyahya
pmc-10654197.description: Objectives: To compare obstetric and neonatal characteristics and birth outcomes between Syrian refugees and native women in Jordan. Methods: We used the Jordan Stillbirths and Neonatal Deaths Surveillance System to extract sociodemographic and obstetric characteristics of the mothers and birth characteristics of newborns.

pmc-11710317.title: Truncated tau accumulates before hyperphosphorylated tau and in relatively distinct neuronal subpopulations in entorhinal cortex and inferior temporal gyrus in Alzheimer’s disease patients
pmc-11710317.creator: Ian Michael Oh, Song Hua Li, Felipe Luiz Pereira, Prabhleen Kaur, Anya Raju, Rushil Jerfy, Claudia Kimie Suemoto, Renata Elaine Paraizo Leite, Vitor Ribeiro Paes, Roberta Diehl Rodriguez, Andrew J. Ambrose, Salvatore Spina, William W. Seeley, Bruce L. Miller, Michelle R. Arkin, Lea T. Grinberg
pmc-11710317.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) features stereotypical spread of hyperphosphorylated tau (p‐tau) and beta‐amyloid. Although other pathological tau posttranslational modifications (PTMs) have been described in AD, a prevalent disease model preconizes that other tau PTMs always coincide with p‐tau, making the latter an excellent marker of pathological tau burden.

pmc-11775473.title: Classification-based pathway analysis using GPNet with novel P-value computation
pmc-11775473.creator: Hao Lu, Mostafa Rezapour, Haseebullah Baha, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi, Aarthi Narayanan, Metin Nafi Gurcan
pmc-11775473.description: Pathway analysis plays a critical role in bioinformatics, enabling researchers to identify biological pathways associated with various conditions by analyzing gene expression data. However, the rise of large, multi-center datasets has highlighted limitations in traditional methods like Over-Representation Analysis (ORA) and Functional Class Scoring (FCS), which struggle with low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and large sample sizes.

pmc-12423230.title: Dual and Single-species Nematode Infections Distinctly Modulate Defense Metabolism in Brassica nigra Roots
pmc-12423230.creator: Jessil Ann Pajar, April Lyn Leonar, Pius Otto, Franziska Sabine Hanschen, Stefanie Döll, Nicole M. van Dam
pmc-12423230.description: Plant roots are exposed to various organisms that significantly impact plant productivity. Plant-parasitic nematodes (PPNs) such as Meloidogyne spp. and Pratylenchus spp. are microscopic roundworms that damage several crops. In natural populations, M. incognita and P. penetrans were found to infest black mustard (Brassica nigra) plants simultaneously.

pmc-12477666.title: More Than Rapid Eye Movement Sleep Behavior Disorder: Sleep Differences in Parkinson’s Disease LRRK2 and GBA Genotypes
pmc-12477666.creator: Adina Wise, Deborah Raymond, Mengxi Yang, Amy Astefanous, Abby Cohen, Melba Beltre, Casey Young, Barbara Plitnick, Susan B Bressman, Mariana G Figueiro, Rachel Saunders-Pullman
pmc-12477666.description: Objectives:Sleep disorders can significantly worsen the quality of life in Parkinson’s disease (PD). Variants in LRRK2 and GBA1, the most common genetic contributors to PD, may lead to different clinical features, including more REM sleep behavior disorder (RBD) in PD associated with GBA1 mutations (GBA PD).

pmc-12518842.title: Diffusion, search and attack motions of antibodies
pmc-12518842.creator: Ralf Biehl, Margarita Kruteva, Orsolya Czakkel, Ingo Hoffmann, Dieter Richter, Andreas M Stadler
pmc-12518842.description: A fundamental feature of the antibody structure is the flexible linker between the 3 fragments that allows great flexibility and simultaneous binding to epitopes of antigens and receptors. Combining dynamic light scattering, neutron spin-echo spectroscopy and PFG-NMR we determine characteristic internal fragment dynamics on top of translational and rotational diffusion under crowding conditions.

pmc-12590679.title: Gestational age-dependent clinical characteristics of necrotizing enterocolitis-associated intestinal perforation: a 10-year cohort study
pmc-12590679.creator: Hong Wei, Weihong Yue, Gege Liu, Feng Chen, Xia Liu, Ya Hu
pmc-12590679.description: ObjectiveTo delineate gestational age (GA)-dependent pathophysiology of necrotizing enterocolitis-associated intestinal perforation (NEC-IP) and establish precision management protocols.MethodsA single-center retrospective cohort study (2013–2023) included 66 preterm (< 37 weeks) and 38 term (≥ 37 weeks) neonates with NEC-associated perforations. Outcomes included anatomical distribution, microbiological profiles, management disparities, and prognoses.ResultsPreterm infants exhibited significantly higher rates of twin gestation (43.9% vs 7.

pmc-12640064.title: Response to the Letter to the Editor Entitled “The Context of Kidney Care in Pacific Island Countries”
pmc-12640064.creator: Yogeshni Chandra, Anis Ta’eed, Shilpanjali Jesudason, Angus Ritchie
pmc-12640064.description: ia region, especially in the middle-income Pacific Island countries, and these contribute to the growing burden of chronic kidney disease. Beyond health system limitations, environmental factors, climate change, and other social and economic determinants of health exert a significant influence on kidney disease risk in the Pacific.

pmc-12731272.title: A formal approach to the hierarchical structures of microbial communities with negative interactions
pmc-12731272.creator: Beatrice Ruth, Bashar Ibrahim, Peter Dittrich
pmc-12731272.description: Microbial communities typically consist of numerous species that coexist through intricate mutual dependencies. Understanding the structure of these communities and the interactions among their species is essential for explaining their functions and predicting their behavior. In this study, we follow the idea that a community organizes itself into a hierarchy of potentially persistent sub-communities.

pmc-12808318.title: A retrospective cohort study on the association between allergic rhinitis, sublingual immunotherapy, and COVID-19 symptomatology
pmc-12808318.creator: Ying-Ying Zhang, Mei-Ping Lu, Yan-Bing Chen, Lin Jiang, Qian Lyu, Yuan Tang, Min Zhang, Lei Cheng
pmc-12808318.description: The impacts of allergic rhinitis (AR) and allergen-specific sublingual immunotherapy (SLIT) on coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) have not been fully understood. Therefore, the aim of this study was to investigate the effects of AR and SLIT on symptoms of COVID-19 within one month after Chinese authorities adjusted their COVID-19 response measures.

pmc-13072516.title: High flow nasal cannula in the emergency department’s resuscitation room: a prospective monocenter descriptive study
pmc-13072516.creator: Juliette Danckaert, Fabien Coisy, Céline Occelli, Sylvain Garnier, Christophe Milesi, Xavier Bobbia, Romain Genre Grandpierre
pmc-13072516.description: BackgroundHigh-flow nasal cannula (HFNC) therapy is commonly used in emergency departments (EDs) to treat acute respiratory failure (ARF). However, its utilization patterns in the resuscitation room (RR) are not well documented. The aim of this study was to describe patient characteristics, management, and in-hospital trajectories according to HFNC use.

pmc-13288050.title: tanggle: An R package for the visualization of phylogenetic networks
pmc-13288050.creator: Klaus Schliep, Marta Vidal‐García, Leann Biancani, L. Francisco Henao‐Díaz, Eren Ada, Joshua Justison, Claudia Solís‐Lemus
pmc-13288050.description: PremisePhylogenetic trees depict evolutionary relationships among taxa. However, they are strictly bifurcating structures that do not take into account several types of evolutionary events such as horizontal gene transfer, hybridization, or introgression. Although the development of new methods in phylogenetic networks has recently increased, limited visualization software is available to plot the phylogenetic networks.

pmc-13617230.title: Idiopathic Orbital Inflammation Masquerading as Relapse of Seronegative Juvenile Myasthenia Gravis: A Case Report
pmc-13617230.creator: Wenhao Duan, Yanqing Zhang, Wensha Nie, Hongchao Jiang, Huiping Wang
pmc-13617230.description: ctival injection, tearing or eyelid oedema. Idiopathic orbital inflammation (IOI) is an uncommon non‐infectious, non‐neoplastic inflammatory disorder of the orbit in children and remains a diagnosis of exclusion. It typically manifests with acute or subacute orbital pain, eyelid swelling, conjunctival injection, tearing and proptosis.
